notes.title: Nominate Shooty Skies Overdrive for VR Game of the Year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098808/f657fb542d071d23fd79b996b8b5136ae0fcb410.png[/img]

The 2020 Steam Awards recognizes excellence in games of all genres, as voted on by the players themselves - you! By casting your vote, you’re helping us bring our game to more people who might also like silly puns, immersive worlds and action-packed gameplay. 

Shooty Skies Overdrive was designed for players of all skill levels, from those seeking a relaxed adventure in “Chill” Mode to those courting certain death in “Overdrive” Mode. Players use their hand to guide a pilot, dodging enemy fire and blasting their way through hostile arcade machines, undead rock stars and evil Hipster bosses. 

We hope you enjoyed the game as much as we enjoyed building it. Help us share the fun!

notes.title: Shooty Skies Overdrive has LAUNCHED!
notes.content:
We at Mighty Games are super happy to have our first Steam VR game launch today. Achievements have been set up and a wide range of VR devices have been tested. Good luck pilots, have fun, and be sure message us on the Steam Community if you have any problems.
